objective: Turn the W25-W26 Redwood UX work and the Trek Bikes pilot finding into a visual pilot rubric plus stronger website-first package and record naming rules.

whatWorked: The resolver moved toward Dealer Hardgoods and Channel Fulfillment.
The Review, ROI / Competitive, Run, and Trace tabs are now easier to pilot than the earlier long-scroll versions.
whatFailed: The package and object names still fell back to generic Finished Good/Product SKU wording in places.
Food/Beverage language such as ingredient and lot readiness leaked into a hardgoods bike scenario.
New websites need stronger product-family extraction before the packet becomes frozen.
finding.decision: Website evidence owns lane package, product seed, product family, and demand moment before conversation notes shape the story.

websiteGuidanceUpdate.antiLeakRule: Dealer hardgoods records must not use ingredient and lot readiness unless the website proves food, beverage, ingredient, or lot-controlled goods.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the consultant enter customer, website, and notes, click Run IDB, and understand why the lane/package was selected without reading a long story card?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Guided intake is first; Story Bar stays compact; recommended lane and product package are visible before Review.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the consultant see what IDB will prepare before reading every record?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Execution Plan Preview appears before the record list; packet summary shows exact Customer, transaction context, proof item, and supporting proof names.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the consultant answer why this matters and why NetSuite wins in under 30 seconds?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Top ROI and competitive point are above expandable proof, assumptions, and objection detail.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the consultant keep moving live without scrolling for the next words?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Live controls, top-three path, presenter script, and exception handling are above deeper detail.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the consultant export/reset the session safely after a handoff or next prospect?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Trace export, packet export, clear trace, and clear session remain obvious and reversible.

fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.question: Can the pilot owner verify whether writes are still blocked, validated, or enabled in the sandbox branch?
fiveConsultantVisualPilotRubric.passSignal: Create-disabled status, pilot gate summary, exact write list, and future record links are compact and not repeated.
